identity: Stormvault is the Accord's high road to the front: the storm watch keeps the passes open while the dead walk them at night, a goblin siege crew chews through the watch's bolts, and a split stone golem guards the stormcrags.

quests.title: Postage and Talons
quests.text: A courier came back with half a dispatch and a very personal opinion of birds. Bring down five Golden Eagles by day in the {name:eagle_crags}, which lie {zone_area:eagle_crags}, so our orders reach the front with the bearers attached. The Accord can argue over the wording once it arrives.
quests.lesson: Contested ground: aggressive hunters by day in the first belt.

quests.title: The Mountain's Night Shift
quests.text: The eagles clock off at dusk, but don't put your weapon away. Rime Strays climb out of the snow in the {name:eagle_crags} and loose arrows at our watch fires; break five of them at night. The mountain works two shifts, and neither of them sleeps.
quests.lesson: One area, two clocks: the night roster differs from the day roster.

quests.title: A Proper Introduction to Rock
quests.text: Bring me four Silversteel Bars and I'll trade you a Silversteel Pickaxe. A dual furnace makes the bars from steel and silver; swearing at an ordinary furnace does not, though I've tested that thoroughly. You'll need it when you dig deep enough for Emberglass, where the rock turns too hard for steel.
quests.lesson: Silversteel from the dual furnace; the silversteel pick opens tier four rock.

quests.title: Good News Travels on Foot
quests.text: Tell Toren Waterbarrel at Cinderline Watch in Ashenward March that the passes are open again. He keeps the Accord supplied, which means every clear road earns him another wagon to worry about. Lend him a hand, then ask after Glassroot Wilds; this front takes mountain, march and forest to hold it.
quests.lesson: Contested circuit: the three zones carry the band together.

quests.title: Alna Keeps Count
quests.text: Report to Alna Archsight at Archshadow Post when you're ready for harder ground. She keeps the sighting line trained on the front while goblins make off with our bolts. Mind your sums around her; she once found a missing crate by counting what the thieves dropped.
quests.lesson: Handoff to the zone's second outpost and its harder ground.

quests.title: Some Assembly Stolen
quests.text: Our missing bolts are holding a goblin siege engine together, which is an insult to every smith who threaded them. Defeat six Siege Goblins or Siege Slingers at the {name:goblin_camp} {dir_from_giver:goblin_camp}. Watch the slingers while you work; they have a distressing knack for finding the gap in a helmet.
quests.lesson: A camp with a ranged minority.

quests.title: No More Bolts for {name:bolt_chewer}
quests.text: {name:bolt_chewer} guards the stolen hardware at the {name:goblin_camp} {dir_from_giver:bolt_chewer}, chewing through the stock between meals. Those bolts took a smith all morning; the beast doesn't even pause to admire the threads. Kill it before another crate ends up between its teeth.
quests.lesson: Normal named leader at its camp; resolves the stolen bolts.

quests.title: Thieves Without Favourites
quests.text: The Waylayers at {name:slatehook} {dir_from_giver:slatehook} rob the Accord and the Throng with admirable fairness. Defeat five of them before they strip another supply train. Use what cover you can; I want a report, not a demonstration of their aim.
quests.lesson: Ranged camp at the top of the zone.

quests.title: A Clearer View of Trouble
quests.text: The sighting line needs new lenses; at present I can spot trouble, but not which trouble. Dig deep below the passes, where the rock turns too hard for a steel pick, and bring me two pieces of Emberglass; take a Silversteel Pickaxe for the job. We'll give the watch a clear view before anyone mistakes a siege engine for a supply cart.
quests.lesson: Mining by depth: Emberglass in tier four rock, the next metal's input.

quests.title: Party: A Crack Is Not a Weakness
quests.text: {name:split_seam_warden} roams the {name:stormcrags} {dir_from_giver:split_seam_warden}, with a crack wide enough to tempt any dwarf with a hammer. Don't mistake that seam for an easy job; this golem can flatten a squad. Bring a party and destroy it, and leave the single-handed masonry to the workshop.
quests.lesson: Elite climax for a group; the route reaches 40 without it.

quests.text: [PH] Beasts by the camp keep the haulers from the lift. Thin them out by day. Real text to follow.
